description:
## Finding (ProjectManager shift 2026-11-18 09:30 UTC)

This is the **codx-api** repository (not `codx-junior-platform`, which already has its own card). `project_changes(scope="all", paths=["codx","api","scripts","tests"])` reports **30 files, +2150/-160 uncommitted**, and the set is no longer just the "efforts" feature:

- Efforts: `ai/smol/constants.py`, `ai/smol/effort.py`, `ai/smol/smol_agent.py` (+135), `efforts/effort_manager.py`, `model/effort.py` (+439), `tools/project_manager_tools.py`, `tools/schedule_task_tool.py`, `tests/test_effort*.py`.
- Security / secrets (needs CISO review before any commit): `security/ciso/vault.py` (+249/-66), `security/ciso/secrets.py`, `security/ciso/policy.py`, `security/ciso/models.py`, `api/secrets.py` (+187/-45), `tools/ciso_tools.py`, `security/user_management.py`, `tests/security/test_secrets_prompt.py` (new).
- Runtime / API: `app.py`, `api/chat.py` (+107), `autonomy/service.py` (+120), `db.py`, `global_settings.py` (+140), `runtime.py`, `model/model.py`, `computer/custom_images.py`.
- Untracked artifact: `api/harness/audit.jsonl`.

Risk: ~2,150 lines of unreviewed, security-sensitive work exist **only in the working tree**. A stray `git stash`/`git checkout`/`git restore` destroys it and nothing backs it up.

## What to do
1. `ciso`: `security_review_changes(scope="all")`. Anything at `require_approval`/`block` must be listed by file before commit.
2. `repository`: cluster the change set — (a) efforts, (b) ciso/secrets, (c) runtime/API, (d) `api/harness/audit.jsonl` (gitignore or delete). One commit per cluster, 50/72 messages.
3. Commit cluster by cluster on a PR branch (`create_pr_branch`) so the tree stops being the single copy. **Never** `git restore`/`stash` a cluster.
4. If a cluster is not ready, park it on a card with its validation status instead of committing it.

## Acceptance
- `git status --short` shows only named/ignored churn.
- Every cluster is committed on a PR branch or parked on a card with a reason.
- CISO verdict for the ciso/secrets cluster is quoted on this card.
- `api/harness/audit.jsonl` is gitignored or removed from the tree.

## Delta since this card was written (PM shift 2, 2026-11-18 09:28 UTC)

The change set is **not frozen** — it is growing while the card sits in the queue.

| When | Files (code paths only: `codx`, `src`, `tests`) | Diff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-11-17 14:22 (shift 1) | 12 | +1641 / −21 |
| 2026-11-18 09:32 (this shift) | **29** | +1302 / −76 |

Widest-touching files now: `codx/junior/model/effort.py` (+439), `codx/junior/api/secrets.py` (+187), `codx/junior/global_settings.py` (+140), `codx/junior/ai/smol/smol_agent.py` (+135), `codx/junior/autonomy/service.py` (+120), `codx/junior/api/chat.py` (+107).

Two consequences for whoever picks this up:
1. **Triage must start with a freeze or a snapshot** (branch + commit, or a worktree copy). Clustering a set that grows between two `project_changes` calls will not converge.
2. The file count moved *down* in diff size but *up* in breadth → the work is being **split into smaller edits across more modules**, i.e. it is actively being developed, not abandoned. Do not discard it.

`codx/junior/api/secrets.py` (+187) is called out in the card title as CISO-relevant; it is now the second-largest file in the set, so the security review (`security_review_changes`) should run on that cluster first.

**Scope correction — the title understates the risk. Do not rely on "30 files (+2150)".**

Measured this shift (`project_changes`, scope=all, vs HEAD): **57 files, +1659 / −116**, and the surface grew in the sensitive area since the card was written:
- `codx/junior/security/ciso/secrets.py` (+38), `ciso/policy.py` (+16), `ciso/models.py` (+46) — **new, unreviewed secret-handling code**
- `codx/junior/api/secrets.py` (+212/−46), `global_settings.py` (+140), `model/effort.py` (+439)
- `smol/smol_agent.py` (+135), `api/chat.py` (+107), `autonomy/service.py` (+120)
- untracked `api/harness/audit.jsonl`

**The title cannot be edited through the API** (`update_task` accepts no `name` field — same class of defect as `a5f95606`), so treat this comment as the authoritative scope. Cluster plan is unchanged and stays 4-way: efforts · ciso/secrets · runtime-API · `audit.jsonl`. CISO verdict must be quoted per cluster before any commit.

Standing risk: this is the **only copy** of ~1,660 lines. A stray `git restore` / `git stash` / branch switch destroys a sprint of work. Commit clusters to a PR branch, do not "clean up".

**Authoritative scope, re-measured 2026-11-18 10:26 UTC — use these numbers, ignore the title and the earlier comment on this card.**

Command: `project_changes(scope="all", paths=["codx","api","tests","scripts"], include_patch=false)`

**31 code files, +2428 / −161 vs `HEAD`** (yesterday 10:14: 12 files, +1641/−21).

### Do not trust the 59-file / +294 total printed by an unfiltered `project_changes`
That number was a **truncation artifact**: the call ran with `max_files=20`, the tool printed "Showing 20 of 59", and the `+294/−34` header counted only the 20 displayed rows. The real delta is +2428/−161. Measure with the `paths` filter and a high `max_files` — otherwise this card will again be triaged against a false, small number.

### Clusters, largest first

| Cluster | Files | Δ | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CISO / secrets** | `security/ciso/vault.py` (+374/−66), `api/secrets.py` (+212/−46), `ciso/secrets.py` (+38), `ciso/models.py` (+46), `ciso/policy.py` (+16), `security/user_management.py` (+16/−3), `tools/ciso_tools.py` (+134) | **~+836** | CISO review **before** commit — this is now the biggest cluster, not the runner-up |
| **Efforts / autonomy** | `model/effort.py` (+439/−7), `autonomy/service.py` (+120), `ai/smol/smol_agent.py` (+135), `efforts/effort_manager.py` (+35/−4), `ai/smol/effort.py` (+16/−8), `ai/smol/constants.py` (+21/−6) | ~+766 | qa verdict — the `d7e0f3fa` block applies here |
| **Kanban / tooling** | `tools/project_manager_tools.py` (+118), `tools/schedule_task_tool.py` (+53/−1), `tools/__init__.py` (+16), `api/chat.py` (+107), `global_settings.py` (+140/−1), `db.py` (+27), `model/model.py` (+13) | ~+474 | review |
| **Tests** | `tests/security/test_secrets_prompt.py` **(new, +92)**, `tests/security/test_secrets_vault.py` (+134/−4), `tests/test_effort_manager.py` (+73), `test_constants` / `test_effort` / `test_recurrence_rearm` | ~+315 | must run green |
| **Runtime / scripts** | `app.py` (+13/−1), `runtime.py` (+1), `computer/custom_images.py` (+2/−3), `scripts/dockerhub_publish.sh` **(new, +14)** | ~+30 | review |
| **Noise — do not commit** | `api/harness/audit.jsonl` (untracked, runtime log) | — | gitignore |

### Two things this measurement changes

1. **`ciso/vault.py` (+374/−66) is the largest single change in the tree.** A vault rewrite is not a "review later" item; it gates the CISO cluster.
2. **`project_manager_tools.py` (+118) and `schedule_task_tool.py` (+53) are modified.** Those are exactly the files behind two open board defects — `a5f95606` (`update_task` silently drops `profiles`) and the missing `wake_at` on the thin `create_task` tool I hit myself this shift. **The fix for both may already be sitting uncommitted in this tree.** Whoever takes this card checks that first: if the fix is present, `a5f95606` is not a coding task but a deploy task, and its priority should drop.

Order of work: backup (`9ce4e7ef`) → CISO review of the vault cluster → 6 commits on one PR branch → `git status` clean except `audit.jsonl`.

## CISO verdict — partial, from shift 2026-11-18 10:2x UTC

**Decision: allow for what exists in this checkout; NOT reviewed: the `security/ciso/*` cluster.**

- **Scope A — `codx-junior-platform` source diff (verified present, 11 files):** `security_review_changes(scope="all", paths=[…])` → **allow**, severity none, 0 findings. Files: `codx/junior/api/secrets.py` (+212/−46), `global_settings.py` (+140/−1), `api/chat.py` (+107), `autonomy/service.py` (+120), `db.py` (+27), `app.py`, `runtime.py`, `computer/custom_images.py`, `efforts/effort_manager.py`, `model/effort.py` (+439), `ai/smol/smol_agent.py` (+135). No credential, no `eval/exec/shell=True`, no injected instruction.
- **Scope B — `api/harness/audit.jsonl` (untracked runtime log):** `security_audit(path="api/harness")` → allow, 0 findings. No secret in it today, but it must never be committed.
- **Scope C — the files this card actually needs reviewed (`security/ciso/vault.py`, `security/ciso/secrets.py`, `security/ciso/policy.py`, `security/ciso/models.py`, `tools/ciso_tools.py`, `security/user_management.py`, `api/secrets.py` +187/−45):** `project_changes(paths=[…])` → **"No changes found"** — that tree is **not in this checkout** (repo root here is `codx-junior-platform`). **I cannot issue a verdict on the vault code from this shift.** Do not read this comment as approval of it.

### Blocking observation
`security_review_changes(scope="all")` on this tree returns **block / critical / 1526 findings**, all `secret.high-entropy-token` inside tracked `.codx/tasks/**` JSON. The gate is therefore permanently red for noise reasons and cannot certify a commit. Filed as a new `IT team` card (untrack `.codx`, then `ignore_paths`) — please land that **before** committing, so the commit can carry a real verdict instead of a suppressed one.

Next step for the owner: run the same review against the codx-api worktree where `security/ciso/vault.py` lives, and paste `security_review_changes` output on this card. Credential-handling code gets no approval without it.

## QA verdict on the STAGED tree (no card sits in `Review`, so this is posted as the gate record on the card that owns the staged diff)

## Decision: require_approval
- Scope: `scope="staged"` — 21 files, 2135 insertions / 133 deletions, branch `main` (matches this card's +2150). Run twice, once with suite `pytest`, once with `pytest:api` — identical verdict.
- Evidence:
  - `qa_review_changes(scope="staged", suite="pytest:api")` → **require_approval**, highest_severity `medium`, **10 findings**, mapping **1/10** sources mapped, `tests_selected: 1`.
  - `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest:api", paths=["tests/security/test_secrets_prompt.py"])` → **allow, 6 passed / 0 failed / 0 errors**, 11.1s. The one new test file in the staged set is **green** and does exercise `api/codx/junior/security/*`.
  - The gate's own run is red for a *tooling* reason, not a code reason: `pytest:api: exited with code 5` (no tests collected) — see the separate false-green card. Failing test ids from the gate: **none** (`tests.failed @ -`); the only run finding is `tests.run-error` (medium).
- Findings (all medium):
  - `change.missing-tests` ×9 — `client/src/components/browsers/CoworkingFileBrowser.vue`, `CoworkingFoldersBrowser.vue`, `CoworkingVolumeExplorer.vue`, `CoworkingVolumeMappings.vue`, `volumeMappings.js`, `client/src/components/chat/ChatFindBar.vue`, `client/src/utils/chatFind.js`, `client/src/utils/taskActivity.js`, `client/src/views/GlobalSettings.vue`.
  - `tests.run-error` ×1 — the gate cannot collect for suite `pytest:api`.
- Blocking item: 9 changed client sources ship with **no mapped test** and none is declared in `qa_policy.ignore_paths`. Medium → not a hard block, but the delivery may not be called *done*: either add/extend tests for the 9 client modules (owner `qa_automation`) or declare them in the policy with a written reason (owner: user decision).
- Owner: `qa_automation` (tests) / user (policy exemption).
- Next command: `qa_review_changes(scope="staged", suite="pytest:api")` after the tests land — expected `allow` with `mapped_sources` ≥ 10.
- Note: `security`-adjacent files in this diff (`api/codx/junior/security/*` tests, `dockerhub_publish.sh`) are staged and **not** QA-blocked by me; the security gate is CISO's call (see the open staged-diff-invisible-to-CISO card).

## Inventory corrected — shift 3, 2026-11-18 12:00 UTC. The title ("30 files, +2150") is stale twice over.

Measured with `project_changes(scope="all")` **in this shift**: **82 files, +2957 / −226**. Do not trust the title number; use this comment.

### Read the 82 correctly: source did NOT balloon, the board did
About **26 of the 82 paths are `.codx/**` control-plane churn** — untracked shift cards for `qa`, `ciso`, `software_developer`, `ProjectManager`, `IT team`, plus `.codx/autonomy/state.json`, `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl` (+302) and two `board.json`. Those accrete on **every shift** and must never be part of a feature commit. That is the same defect as card `39a2d6a4` (control-plane data tracked in the repo). Strip them mentally and the tree is ~**56 real files** — consistent with the 57 measured at 10:14. **The tree is not out of control; the noise is.**

### Genuinely new source since 10:14 (this is the part that matters)
- **Whole new `voice` feature, still untracked**: `codx/junior/voice/{__init__,model,service,speech,store}.py`, `codx/junior/api/voice.py`, `codx/junior/tools/voice_tools.py`, `codx/junior/media/providers/voice_openai.py`, `tests/voice/{__init__,test_voice_api,test_voice_service,test_voice_speech,test_voice_store}.py` — plus edits to `media/providers.py`, `app.py`, `tools/__init__.py`.
- `codx/junior/security/ciso/vault.py` grew to **+374/−66** (was +374 in the earlier read — now the single largest file in the tree).
- New: `scripts/dockerhub_publish.sh` (A), `tests/security/test_secrets_prompt.py` (A, +92).

### Commit plan — 4 clusters, in this order, each independently reviewable
1. **`ciso` vault/secrets** — `security/ciso/{vault,secrets,policy,models}.py`, `api/secrets.py` (+212/−46), `tools/ciso_tools.py` (+134), `tests/security/*`, `docs/design/secrets-resolver.md`. **Highest risk: security-sensitive. Review first, in isolation, nothing else in the commit.**
2. **`voice`** (new feature, self-contained) — the 9 untracked files above + `media/providers.py`, `app.py`, `tools/__init__.py`. Ships behind settings; no migration.
3. **`efforts`** — `model/effort.py` (+439), `efforts/effort_manager.py` (+35), `ai/smol/{effort,constants,smol_agent}.py`, `tests/test_effort*.py`, `tests/test_constants.py`.
4. **platform / tooling** — `db.py`, `model/model.py`, `runtime.py`, `user_management.py`, `custom_images.py`, `api/chat.py`, `global_settings.py` (+140), `autonomy/service.py` (+120), `tools/{project_manager_tools,schedule_task_tool,dockerhub_tools}.py`, `scripts/dockerhub_publish.sh`.

### DO NOT COMMIT — build/test artefacts
`pytest-qa-report.xml` (untracked, produced by a QA run), `api/harness/audit.jsonl`, `harness/audit.jsonl`, and every `.codx/**` path. Add them to `.gitignore` in cluster 4 rather than deleting them.

### Sequencing note (this is why the date is at risk)
Nothing here can execute until card **`18bca0e1`** lands — no profile holds a shell tool, so `git add`/`git commit` cannot be run by an agent. I have set that card to **high / due 2026-11-18**. `9ce4e7ef` (snapshot to `$HOME`) must run **before** the first commit, not after. Therefore 19 Nov stays the target for clusters 1–2 only; clusters 3–4 move to 20 Nov unless `18bca0e1` closes today.

### Two cross-links worth knowing
- `tools/project_manager_tools.py` (+118) is part of this tree and is where the `update_task`-drops-`profiles` defect (`a5f95606`) very likely lives — fix it inside cluster 4, do not open a fifth commit.
- The `pytest:api` false green (`e5841226`) and the `tests.run-error` in the QA gate will not be fixed by committing; they are separate cards.

**Do not run `project_locate`/`project_map`/`project_trace`/`read_folder` in this repo** — they hang 120 s (`d8534b12`). Use shell + `git` once `18bca0e1` is resolved.

**QA shift 5 — the working-tree gate is `require_approval`, and here is the exact list it wants before this tree can be committed.**

`qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=false)` → **require_approval / medium / 11 findings**, changed files 220 (144 of them tests), **mapped sources 35, unmapped sources 58**, coverage: none.

The 10 api sources that stop the gate with `change.missing-tests` (medium), each needing a test file named after the module **or** an entry in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a reason:

- `api/codx/junior/api/browser_models.py`
- `api/codx/junior/browser/actions.py`

(+1 more truncated in the tool output — re-run the command below to print it.)

This is a **split/declare decision, not a test-writing sprint**: `db.py`, `global_settings.py`, `security/user_management.py` and `security/ciso/policy.py` are infrastructure that realistically belongs in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a written reason; the `browser/*` and `computer/custom_images.py` group is where a real module test is worth writing. Note the two client-side groups (`client/src/api/*`, 9 modules) are tracked separately in card 448b0447.

Re-verification command: `qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=false)` → expect ≤ 1 finding (the truncated one) once each path is tested or declared. Reminder from this shift: the api tree itself is red (`tests` → 1433 passed / 3 failed, card cdff59e2), so a green gate for this tree also needs that card closed.
